items.title: ProtModernBERT: Compute-Efficient Protein Language Modeling
items.abstract_or_text: Large protein language models provide a powerful framework for learning sequence-function relationships and guiding experimental design. However, architectural improvements are underexplored, especially in low-compute regimes of relevance for resource-constrained research laboratories. We show that the training cost for encoder-only transformer architectures can be reduced by leveraging modern architectural refinements, offering an encouraging performance / compute-efficiency trade-off. We introduce ProtModernBERT, a modernized BERT-style model pre-trained on amino acid sequences, and compare it with ProtBert, Amplify, and ESM2 across a set of supervised structural tasks -encompassing secondary structure prediction, disorder prediction, and subcellular localization- and ProteinGym's zero-shot functional benchmark. We find that ProtModernBERT matches or closely tracks the performance of Amplify-120M and ProtBert with up to 80-90\% reduction in pre-training FLOPs, and narrows the gap to ESM2 when controlling for pre-training. Our analysis using a cluster-based validation protocol for hyperparameter selection and randomly initialized models disentangles the contributions of architecture and data, showing that modern components provide stronger inductive biases that are more consequential than parameter count in low-compute regimes.
items.summary_zh: 提出计算高效的蛋白质语言模型ProtModernBERT，采用现代BERT架构，在二级结构、无序区、亚细胞定位和ProteinGym零样本任务上，以减少80–90%的预训练FLOPs接近ProtBert和Amplify表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 说明架构归纳偏置在低算力蛋白建模中可能比参数量更关键，对资源受限实验室有现实意义。仍需注意比较依赖预训练控制方案，且摘要未给出各任务的绝对性能与外部实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 大型蛋白质语言模型为学习序列–功能关系和指导实验设计提供了强大框架。然而，架构改进仍未得到充分探索，尤其是在与资源受限研究实验室相关的低算力条件下。我们表明，通过采用现代架构改进，可以降低仅编码器Transformer架构的训练成本，从而获得有希望的性能/计算效率权衡。我们提出ProtModernBERT，一种在氨基酸序列上预训练的现代化BERT风格模型，并在一组有监督结构任务——包括二级结构预测、无序区预测和亚细胞定位——以及ProteinGym零样本功能基准上，将其与ProtBert、Amplify和ESM2进行比较。我们发现，在控制预训练条件时，ProtModernBERT的性能与Amplify-120M和ProtBert相当或接近，同时预训练FLOPs减少了80–90%，并缩小了与ESM2之间的差距。我们使用基于聚类的验证方案选择超参数，并使用随机初始化模型进行分析，从而区分架构和数据的贡献；结果表明，在低算力条件下，现代组件提供了更强的归纳偏置，其影响比参数量更为重要。
items.author_line: Alberto Martínez, Natalia Flechas Manrique, Llorenç Espinosa-Portalés, Luc Andrea

items.title: Progerin disrupts intestinal epithelial homeostasis by impairing mitochondrial metabolism and absorptive enterocyte maturation
items.abstract_or_text: Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome (HGPS) is a segmental premature ageing disease that predominantly affects tissues with high regenerative capacity. Although the intestine is the most rapidly self-renewing tissue of adult mammals, it has so far been considered only as a source of microbiota-derived disturbances in progeria, and whether the intestinal epithelium is itself a target of progerin remains unknown. Here, using the LmnaG609G/G609G and LmnaG609G/+ mouse models, intestinal organoids and single-cell RNA sequencing, we show that progerin is expressed in colonic enterocytes and in SMA+ subepithelial myofibroblasts of the stem-cell niche. Heterozygous progeria mice develop increased intestinal permeability from 30 weeks of age, reaching levels reported in physiologically aged (>20-month-old) mice. Progeria-derived intestinal organoids display reduced mitochondrial oxygen consumption, a compensatory increase in glycolysis and impaired crypt budding. Single-cell transcriptomics of the colonic epithelium and lamina propria revealed that, while lineage composition is preserved, progerin induces a coordinated reprogramming characterised by repression of oxidative phosphorylation and mitochondrial quality-control genes, including Nod2, activation of interferon, TNF-NF-kB and innate defence programs, and up-regulation of RNA-processing and chromatin-associated pathways. Trajectory analysis showed that progeria absorptive enterocytes selectively fail to reach terminal differentiation states and retain progenitor-like WNT, NOTCH and EGFR signatures, while lacking the mitochondrial programs required for maturation. Together, these findings identify the intestinal epithelium as a cell-intrinsic target of progerin and support a model in which mitochondrial insufficiency stalls absorptive enterocyte maturation and weakens the intestinal barrier, recapitulating, prematurely, key features of colon ageing.
items.summary_zh: 预印本；在两种 LmnaG609G 小鼠模型、肠道类器官和单细胞转录组中，研究显示 progerin 伴随线粒体代谢受损、肠屏障通透性升高及吸收性肠细胞成熟停滞。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把早衰综合征的细胞内在表型扩展到肠上皮，并提出线粒体不足连接成熟障碍与屏障弱化的机制模型。
items.abstract_zh: Hutchinson-Gilford 早衰症（HGPS）是一种节段性早衰疾病，主要影响再生能力高的组织。尽管肠道是成年哺乳动物中自我更新最快的组织，但迄今为止它在早衰症中仅被视为微生物群来源扰动的来源，肠上皮本身是否是 progerin 的靶点仍未知。在这里，我们使用 LmnaG609G/G609G 和 LmnaG609G/+ 小鼠模型、肠道类器官和单细胞 RNA 测序，显示 progerin 在结肠吸收性肠细胞和干细胞生态位中的 SMA+ 黏膜下肌成纤维细胞中表达。杂合早衰小鼠从30周龄起出现肠道通透性增加，达到生理性衰老（>20月龄）小鼠中所报道的水平。早衰来源的肠道类器官表现出线粒体耗氧量降低、代偿性糖酵解增加和隐窝出芽受损。结肠上皮和固有层的单细胞转录组显示，虽然谱系组成得以保留，但 progerin 诱导了协调性的重编程，其特征包括氧化磷酸化和线粒体质量控制基因（包括 Nod2）的抑制、干扰素、TNF-NF-kB 和先天防御程序的激活，以及 RNA 加工和染色质相关通路的上调。轨迹分析显示，早衰症吸收性肠细胞选择性地无法达到终末分化状态，并保留祖细胞样的 WNT、NOTCH 和 EGFR 特征，同时缺乏成熟所需的线粒体程序。总之，这些发现将肠上皮确定为 progerin 的细胞内在靶点，并支持这样一种模型：线粒体不足使吸收性肠细胞成熟停滞并削弱肠屏障，从而提前重现结肠衰老的关键特征。
items.author_line: Reisacher, C., Singh, M., Arbibe, L.

items.title: DNA-LLM2Vec: Architecture-Aware Task-Conditioned Adaptation of Decoder DNA Foundation Models
items.abstract_or_text: Decoder DNA foundation models pretrain with dense next-token prediction and scale to long sequences, but their representations are directional. This is a poor fit for genomic tasks that need sequence context both upstream and downstream of a locus. Bidirectional masked-language-model encoders supply this context, but they pretrain more sparsely and scale less easily to long windows. We introduce DNA-LLM2Vec, a staged decoder-to-encoder framework that opens bidirectional context, repairs the resulting mismatch with masked next-token prediction, and applies contrastive views encoding strand and positional invariance. We instantiate it on two architecturally distinct backbones, DNAGPT and HyenaDNA, and evaluate seven biological task families (grouped from GB, NT, GUE, and GUE+EPI) with frozen linear probing. The benefits of conversion are architecture-aware and task-conditioned rather than uniform. Crop-based positional contrastive learning helps most for the extended-context families (enhancer-promoter interaction and Virus-COVID), raising frozen Avg-EPI MCC to 27.5% for DNAGPT and 26.7% for HyenaDNA, whereas for shorter, local families the results depend on backbone and tokenisation. Beyond classification, bidirectional context and MNTP improve causal-eQTL variant-effect prediction specifically at distance, and a base-pair mutagenesis diagnostic shows that adaptation organises motif-aware contact structure while reverse-complement training imprints strand-consistent geometry, yet neither predicts the best downstream view. DNA-LLM2Vec therefore produces frozen bidirectional representations whose most effective adaptation view depends on the task structure and the backbone. Code and checkpoints are available at https://github.com/semi-nothing/dna-llm2vec.
items.summary_zh: 预印本；DNA-LLM2Vec 将方向性的解码器 DNA 基础模型改造成双向、任务条件化表示，并在七类生物任务上评估，代码和检查点已公开。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 显示双向上下文收益取决于骨干架构和任务结构，为基因组基础模型的低成本适配提供可复现路线。
items.abstract_zh: 解码器 DNA 基础模型通过密集的下一词元预测进行预训练并扩展到长序列，但其表示具有方向性。这不适合需要同时利用位点上游和下游序列上下文的基因组任务。双向掩码语言模型编码器提供了这种上下文，但其预训练更加稀疏，且在长窗口上的扩展性较差。我们提出 DNA-LLM2Vec，一种分阶段的解码器到编码器框架：它开启双向上下文，使用掩码下一词元预测修复由此产生的不匹配，并应用编码链和位置不变性的对比视图。我们在两个架构不同的骨干模型 DNAGPT 和 HyenaDNA 上实例化该方法，并使用冻结线性探针评估七类生物学任务（由 GB、NT、GUE 和 GUE+EPI 汇总而成）。转换带来的收益具有架构感知和任务条件化特征，而不是一致出现。基于裁剪的位置对比学习对扩展上下文类别（增强子-启动子相互作用和 Virus-COVID）最为有益，使 DNAGPT 的冻结 Avg-EPI MCC 提升至 27.5%，HyenaDNA 提升至 26.7%；而对于较短的局部类别，结果取决于骨干模型和词元化方式。除分类外，双向上下文和 MNTP 还特异性地改善了远距离因果 eQTL 变异效应预测；碱基对诱变诊断显示，适配使表示组织出具有基序意识的接触结构，而反向互补训练则印刻了链一致的几何结构，但这两者都不能预测最佳的下游视图。因此，DNA-LLM2Vec 生成了冻结的双向表示，其最有效的适配视图取决于任务结构和骨干模型。代码和检查点见 https://github.com/semi-nothing/dna-llm2vec。
items.author_line: Liang, Y., Zhai, K., Gan, Y., Li, S., Shao, J., Watson, G. H., Poesio, M.

items.title: Serum proteins predict incident inflammatory bowel disease 14 years before diagnosis: a machine-learning and Cox modelling in the UK Biobank
items.abstract_or_text: Using an analysis pipeline that combines machine learning-based feature selection with classical statistical modelling, we aimed to predict incident inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and to identify candidate proteins associated with disease development. We used UK Biobank data in an observational cohort study of 52,331 participants with proteomics data and without a history of IBD. The cohort was split into an 80/20 train/test dataset, and three separate extreme gradient boosting models were trained on the training dataset. Using Shapley values, we ranked the predictive importance of 2,912 proteins for incident IBD, Crohn's disease (CD), and ulcerative colitis (UC). The top 20 proteins per outcome served as features in multivariate Cox models predicting 350 incident cases over 14 years. All three proteomics Cox models showed moderate discrimination in the test dataset, with the UC model performing the best (C-index: 0.68), followed by IBD (C-index: 0.65), and CD (C-index: 0.60). All proteomics models outperformed clinical models. Smoking remained the only significant clinical predictor in the combined proteomics + clinical model. 48 unique proteins were identified across the three models, with 16 reaching statistical significance (p< 0.05). Machine learning-based feature selection with statistical survival modelling identifies plasma proteins that predict incident IBD and highlight biologically plausible, potentially targetable pathways in the preclinical phase of IBD.
items.summary_zh: 临床相关预印本；UK Biobank 的52,331名参与者和14年随访显示，蛋白质组特征可中等程度预测 IBD、Crohn's disease 和 ulcerative colitis 的发病风险。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在诊断前长期窗口中筛出48种候选蛋白，但观察性设计和中等 C-index 不支持因果或临床应用结论。
items.abstract_zh: 我们使用结合机器学习特征选择与经典统计建模的分析流程，旨在预测新发炎症性肠病（IBD）并识别与疾病发生相关的候选蛋白。我们在一项观察性队列研究中使用 UK Biobank 的数据，纳入52,331名具有蛋白质组学数据且既往无 IBD 病史的参与者。队列按80/20分为训练集和测试集，在训练集上训练了三个独立的极端梯度提升模型。我们利用 Shapley 值对2,912种蛋白质在新发 IBD、Crohn's disease 和 ulcerative colitis 预测中的重要性进行排序。每个结局的前20种蛋白质作为特征，进入预测14年内350例新发病例的多变量 Cox 模型。三个蛋白质组 Cox 模型在测试数据中均表现出中等区分度，其中 ulcerative colitis 模型最好（C-index：0.68），其次为 IBD（C-index：0.65）和 Crohn's disease（C-index：0.60）。所有蛋白质组模型均优于临床模型。在蛋白质组加临床模型中，吸烟仍是唯一显著的临床预测因子。在三个模型中共识别出48种不同蛋白质，其中16种达到统计学显著性（p< 0.05）。基于机器学习的特征选择结合统计生存建模，能够识别预测 IBD 发病的血浆蛋白，并提示临床前 IBD 阶段具有生物学合理性且可能可靶向的通路。
items.author_line: Niebuhr, T. E., Fieggen, J., Segal, B. M., Patel, A., Clifton, D. A., Clifton, L.

items.title: Scaling Multilingual Safety and Reasoning Evaluation through Reasoning-Guided Translation
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across languages, yet their safety and reasoning capabilities remain predominantly evaluated in English. Translating existing benchmarks offers a scalable approach to multilingual evaluation, but preserving task-specific meaning across languages presents significant challenges, particularly for harmful requests, mathematical reasoning, and conversational interactions. We introduce a reasoning-guided translation framework for constructing multilingual evaluations designed to preserve the structure and intended meaning of diverse benchmark tasks. Our approach separates translation strategy selection from large-scale generation, combining reasoning-guided configuration selection with task-aware validation, targeted repair, and independent quality screening. Using this framework, we develop a source-aligned evaluation collection spanning seven safety, conversational, and mathematical reasoning resources across 11 languages. The resulting collection achieves 99.94\% coverage of intended item--language pairs in the two subsets requiring repair. Evaluations of open-source LLMs reveal distinct language-dependent vulnerabilities, including inconsistent refusal behaviour and substantial reasoning degradation in lower-resource languages. These findings highlight the importance of task-sensitive benchmark construction and systematic quality assessment for understanding multilingual model behaviour beyond English.
items.summary_zh: 该工作用推理引导翻译构建覆盖 11 种语言的安全、对话和数学推理评测集，并进行任务级验证、修复和独立质检，报告低资源语言中的推理退化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它关注数学基准跨语言迁移时的语义保持和质量控制，提供覆盖率与模型评测结果，避免把机器翻译后的分数直接当作能力结论。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正被部署到多种语言中，但其安全和推理能力仍主要在英语中评估。翻译现有基准是构建多语言评测的一种可扩展方法，但在不同语言中保持任务特定的含义具有挑战性，尤其是有害请求、数学推理和对话交互。我们提出一种推理引导的翻译框架，用于构建旨在保持多样基准任务结构和预期含义的多语言评测。该方法将翻译策略选择与大规模生成分离，并结合推理引导的配置选择、任务感知验证、定向修复和独立质量筛查。利用这一框架，我们构建了一个与源数据对齐的评测集合，覆盖 11 种语言中的七个安全、对话和数学推理资源。在需要修复的两个子集中，最终集合达到了预期条目—语言配对的 99.94% 覆盖率。对开源 LLM 的评测揭示了与语言有关的不同脆弱性，包括拒答行为不一致，以及低资源语言中显著的推理退化。这些结果凸显了任务敏感的基准构建和系统化质量评估对于理解超越英语的模型行为的重要性。
items.author_line: Zahraa Al Sahili, Ioannis Patras, Matthew Purver

items.title: QUPEX: A Streamlit-Based Framework for Visualizing Quantum-Mechanical Property Spaces of Organic Molecules
items.abstract_or_text: The growing availability of quantum-mechanical (QM) datasets offers new opportunities to investigate structure-property and property-property relationships in drug-like molecules using data-driven methods. However, interactive tools that integrate molecular visualization, statistical analysis of QM properties, clustering, and machine learning (ML) remain limited, despite their value in facilitating dataset exploration and interpretation. To address this gap, we introduce QUPEX (QUantum Property EXplorer), an open-source Streamlit-based framework for the interactive exploration of QM property spaces in molecular systems. As a demonstration, we apply QUPEX to a subset of the QM7-X dataset comprising 41,537 equilibrium molecular structures containing up to seven non-hydrogen atoms (C, N, O, S, and Cl) and their 24 associated QM properties. In addition to property-space analysis, QUPEX incorporates an XGBoost regression pipeline for predicting PBE0 dipole moments from tight-binding-derived electronic descriptors, together with model evaluation and SHAP-based interpretability functionality. By combining interactive molecular visualization, data analysis, and predictive modeling, QUPEX provides an accessible and extensible environment for investigating molecular datasets and identifying patterns in their structural and electronic properties. These capabilities can support the exploration of chemical space and inform the rational design of drug-like molecules with targeted QM properties.
items.summary_zh: 发布开源Streamlit框架QUPEX，用于交互式探索有机分子的量子力学性质空间，集成分子可视化、统计分析、聚类、XGBoost预测和SHAP解释，并在QM7-X的41,537个结构和24项性质上演示。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 降低量子化学数据探索和可解释建模的使用门槛，适合药物样分子性质空间分析。示例数据仅覆盖最多七个非氢原子的分子，预测目标和描述符体系的适用范围有限。
items.abstract_zh: 量子力学（QM）数据集日益丰富，为使用数据驱动方法研究类药物分子中的结构–性质和性质–性质关系提供了新机会。然而，能够整合分子可视化、量子力学性质统计分析、聚类和机器学习（ML）的交互式工具仍然有限，尽管这些工具有助于数据集探索和解释。为弥补这一空白，我们提出QUPEX（QUantum Property EXplorer），一个基于开源Streamlit的框架，用于交互式探索分子体系的QM性质空间。作为示范，我们将QUPEX应用于QM7-X数据集的一个子集，该子集包含41,537个平衡分子结构，分子最多含七个非氢原子（C、N、O、S和Cl），并具有24项相关QM性质。除性质空间分析外，QUPEX还包含一个XGBoost回归流程，用于根据由紧束缚方法得到的电子描述符预测PBE0偶极矩，并提供模型评估和基于SHAP的可解释性功能。通过结合交互式分子可视化、数据分析和预测建模，QUPEX提供了一个易用且可扩展的环境，用于研究分子数据集并识别其结构和电子性质中的模式。这些能力可以支持化学空间探索，并为具有目标QM性质的类药物分子的理性设计提供信息。
items.author_line: Mirtha Pillaca Quispe, Alejandra Hinostroza Caldas, Leonardo Medrano Sandonas

items.title: Does Pretraining Teach Chemical Language Models Chemistry?
items.abstract_or_text: Chemical language models (CLMs) are pretrained on large corpora of molecules with the aim of learning representations that transfer to diverse downstream tasks. Here, we systematically study the effects of pretraining using a series of such CLMs across 64 molecular property prediction datasets. We find that the downstream gains of pretraining in CLMs do not scale and performance saturates below gradient-boosting baselines. Across the regimes evaluated, only supervised pretraining on traditional physico-chemical descriptors consistently improves downstream performance for the CLMs tested whereas some forms of pretraining result in models worse than a randomly initialized encoder. While models can resolve molecular structure well, they do so no better than a randomly initialized model, suggesting that, at best, CLMs learn descriptor-like properties in addition to low-level token statistics during pretraining, but surprisingly little chemistry beyond what classical molecular features already capture.
items.summary_zh: 系统评估化学语言模型在64个分子性质预测数据集上的预训练收益，发现收益并不随规模增长、性能低于梯度提升基线，只有基于传统物化描述符的监督预训练稳定带来改进。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对“分子语料预训练自然学到化学”的常见假设提出直接反证，强调与强传统基线和随机初始化模型比较的重要性。摘要未给出数据集逐项结果，结论可能受所选CLM和预训练方案限制。
items.abstract_zh: 化学语言模型（CLM）在大规模分子语料上进行预训练，目标是学习能够迁移到多种下游任务的表示。本文在64个分子性质预测数据集上，系统研究一系列此类CLM的预训练效果。我们发现，CLM中预训练带来的下游收益并不随规模增长，并且性能在梯度提升基线以下趋于饱和。在所评估的各种设置中，只有基于传统物理化学描述符的监督预训练，能对所测试的CLM持续改善下游性能；而某些预训练形式产生的模型甚至比随机初始化的编码器更差。虽然模型能够较好地解析分子结构，但并不优于随机初始化模型，这表明CLM充其量是在预训练过程中学到了类似描述符的性质以及低层次token统计，令人意外的是，它们学到的化学知识很少超出经典分子特征已经捕捉的内容。
items.author_line: Leif Sieben, Yoel Zimmermann

items.title: Joint Neural Posterior Estimation and Model Selection for Chemical Reaction Networks
items.abstract_or_text: Simulation-based Bayesian inference for Chemical Reaction Networks (CRNs) must simultaneously solve two computationally demanding problems: discriminating between overlapping reaction pathways and estimating reaction rate constants. Classical approaches, such as Sequential Monte Carlo ABC, rely on handcrafted summary statistics and scale poorly across large parameter spaces. To overcome this, we introduce a neural inference architecture. Our pipeline utilizes shared 1D-CNNs and a permutation-invariant Set Attention mechanism to learn low-dimensional summary statistics from variable-length, multi-experiment time-series data. These statistics simultaneously condition a model selection network to compute posterior model probabilities and model-specific conditional Invertible Neural Networks (cINNs) that estimate parameter posterior distributions. We demonstrate the practical utility of our approach on a real protodeboronation example, illustrating how it handles structural ambiguity and extracts kinetic parameters from competing catalyst deactivation pathways.
items.summary_zh: 针对化学反应网络中反应路径区分和速率常数估计的联合困难，提出共享1D-CNN、置换不变Set Attention和模型专属cINN的神经推断流程，并在真实protodeboronation案例中提取竞争催化剂失活路径的后验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将模拟式贝叶斯推断中的模型选择与参数后验估计统一起来，避免手工摘要统计量。当前摘要只报告一个真实案例，尚不足以判断对更大反应网络和实验噪声的稳健性。
items.abstract_zh: 化学反应网络（CRN）的基于模拟的贝叶斯推断必须同时解决两个计算上要求很高的问题：区分重叠的反应路径，以及估计反应速率常数。经典方法（如Sequential Monte Carlo ABC）依赖手工设计的摘要统计量，并且在大参数空间中扩展性较差。为克服这些问题，我们提出一种神经推断架构。我们的流程使用共享的1D-CNN和置换不变的Set Attention，从可变长度、多实验时间序列数据中学习低维摘要统计量。这些统计量同时为模型选择网络提供条件，并为模型专属的条件可逆神经网络（cINN）提供条件，以估计参数后验分布。我们在真实的protodeboronation案例上展示了该方法的实用性，说明它能够处理结构歧义，并从竞争的催化剂失活路径中提取动力学参数。
items.author_line: J. Arturo Esquivel, Jorge A. Campos-Gonzalez-Angulo, Sergio Pablo-García, Alán Aspuru-Guzik, Vianey Leos-Barajas

items.title: Structural Resolution in Feature Attribution Analysis of Molecular Graph Neural Networks
items.abstract_or_text: Machine learning models based on molecular graphs can evaluate the contribution of each atom to a prediction using feature attribution methods. However, in chemistry, molecular properties are frequently discussed in terms of both individual atoms and structural units comprising multiple atoms, e.g., functional groups and substituents. In this study, we defined the granularity of the structural units used to present and evaluate feature attributions as their structural resolution, and we investigated how the relationship between feature attributions obtained from different molecular graph models varied with structural resolution. These attributions were evaluated at two structural resolutions, i.e., individual atoms and chemically defined structural groups. The group-level feature attributions exhibited higher intermodel agreement than the corresponding atom-level attributions for every target property and model pair. These results indicate that although the allocation of contributions to individual atoms can vary depending on the model architecture, the contribution patterns shared across multiple models can be retained at the level of entire structural groups.
items.summary_zh: 研究分子图神经网络特征归因的结构分辨率，比较原子级与化学结构组级归因，发现组级归因在所有目标性质和模型对之间具有更高的跨模型一致性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为化学机器学习解释提供了与官能团和取代基相匹配的评价粒度，提示原子级归因的模型依赖性可能被结构组级模式缓解。摘要未给出模型、性质和数据集的规模，结论的普适性需进一步检验。
items.abstract_zh: 基于分子图的机器学习模型可以使用特征归因方法评估每个原子对预测的贡献。然而，在化学领域，分子性质经常同时以单个原子和由多个原子组成的结构单元来讨论，例如官能团和取代基。在本研究中，我们将用于呈现和评估特征归因的结构单元粒度定义为结构分辨率，并研究不同分子图模型所得特征归因之间的关系如何随结构分辨率变化。这些归因在两种结构分辨率下进行评估，即单个原子和化学定义的结构组。对于每一个目标性质和模型对，组级特征归因都表现出高于相应原子级归因的模型间一致性。这些结果表明，尽管对单个原子的贡献分配可能随模型架构而变化，但多个模型共享的贡献模式可以在完整结构组的层面保留下来。
items.author_line: Teruhisa Sadakane, Daisuke Yokogawa

items.title: CPIExtract: A software package to collect and harmonize small molecule and protein interactions
items.abstract_or_text: Summary: The binding interactions between small molecules and proteins are the basis of cellular functions. Yet, experimental data available regarding compound-protein interaction are not harmonized into a single entity but rather scattered across multiple institutions, each maintaining databases with different formats. Extracting information from these multiple sources remains challenging due to data heterogeneity. Here, we present CPIExtract (Compound-Protein Interaction Extract), a tool to interactively extract experimental binding interaction data from multiple databases, perform filtering, and harmonize the resulting information, thus providing a gain of compound-protein interaction data. When compared to a single source, DrugBank, we show that it can collect more than ten times the number of annotations. The end-user can apply custom filtering to the aggregated output data and save it in any generic tabular file suitable for further downstream tasks such as network medicine analyses for drug repurposing and cross-validation of deep learning models. Availability: CPIExtract is an open-source Python package under an MIT license. CPIExtract can be installed from https://pypi.org/project/cpiextract and downloaded from https://github.com/menicgiulia/CPIExtract. The package can run on any standard desktop computer or computing cluster.
items.summary_zh: 发布CPIExtract开源Python包，从多个数据库交互式提取、过滤并统一小分子–蛋白质实验结合数据；相较DrugBank单一来源可收集十倍以上标注，并支持药物再利用分析和深度学习交叉验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 缓解化合物–蛋白质相互作用数据分散和格式异构问题，可作为药物再利用与模型训练的数据基础。摘要显示其来源整合能力强，但数据质量、重复记录和许可兼容性仍需使用者自行核验。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：小分子与蛋白质之间的结合相互作用是细胞功能的基础。然而，现有关于化合物–蛋白质相互作用的实验数据并未统一为单一实体，而是分散在多个机构中；每个机构维护的数据库格式各不相同。由于数据异质性，从这些多种来源提取信息仍然具有挑战性。本文提出CPIExtract（Compound-Protein Interaction Extract），一种可交互地从多个数据库提取实验结合相互作用数据、执行过滤并统一所得信息的工具，从而增加化合物–蛋白质相互作用数据量。与单一来源DrugBank相比，我们展示了该工具能够收集十倍以上的标注。最终用户可以对聚合输出数据应用自定义过滤，并将其保存为适用于下游任务的通用表格文件，例如网络医学分析中的药物再利用和深度学习模型的交叉验证。可用性：CPIExtract是一个采用MIT许可证的开源Python包。CPIExtract可从https://pypi.org/project/cpiextract安装，并从https://github.com/menicgiulia/CPIExtract下载。该软件包可以在任何标准桌面计算机或计算集群上运行。

items.title: MRI Biomarkers for Brain Metastases in Lung Cancer Using Machine Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Purpose: Existing prognostic models for brain metastases from lung cancer rely on clinical variables and do not capture the biological heterogeneity of host or tumor factors underlying survival outcomes. We evaluated whether MRI-derived radiomic biomarkers improve prognostic stratification beyond clinical variables. We also investigated their biological correlates using matched histopathology. Experimental Design: This retrospective study included 103 patients with brain metastases from lung cancer and matched pre-operative MRI and histopathology. Radiomic features from T1-weighted contrast-enhanced and T2-weighted fluid-attenuated inversion recovery sequences were combined with clinical variables to train Cox proportional hazards, random survival forest, and DeepSurv models for overall survival (OS), CNS progression, and leptomeningeal (LM) progression. Risk groups from an imaging-only model were compared for clinical and histopathologic differences. Results: Imaging features improved prognostic performance beyond clinical variables across all modeling frameworks, with the combined clinical-imaging DeepSurv model achieving the highest concordance index for OS (0.728). Risk groups from the best-performing model for each endpoint differed significantly in OS (median 26.7 vs. 9.1 months, p < 0.001) and LM progression (p = 0.003), but not in CNS progression. Imaging-only risk groups did not differ significantly in any clinical variable, but high-risk patients were less likely to have tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (46% vs. 77%, p = 0.010) and PD-L1 expression [≥] 50% (10% vs. 32%, p = 0.049). Conclusions: MRI radiomic biomarkers provide prognostic information beyond established clinical variables in lung cancer brain metastases and correspond to features of the tumor immune microenvironment, supporting their potential to refine risk stratification.

items.why_it_matters_zh: 提示影像生物标志物可补充临床预后模型，但研究为回顾性单队列，尚需外部和前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：现有肺癌脑转移预后模型依赖临床变量，不能捕捉宿主或肿瘤因素所代表的生物学异质性，而这些因素构成生存结局的基础。我们评估了 MRI 衍生的影像组学生物标志物是否能在临床变量之外改善预后分层。我们还利用配对组织病理学研究其生物学相关性。实验设计：这项回顾性研究纳入103例肺癌脑转移患者，并获得术前 MRI 和配对组织病理学。研究将 T1 加权增强序列和 T2 加权液体衰减反转恢复序列的影像组学特征与临床变量结合，训练 Cox 比例风险模型、随机生存森林和 DeepSurv 模型，用于总体生存（OS）、中枢神经系统进展和软脑膜（LM）进展预测。将仅基于影像的模型划分的风险组进行临床和组织病理学差异比较。结果：在所有建模框架中，影像特征均在临床变量之外改善了预后表现，其中临床-影像联合 DeepSurv 模型对 OS 的一致性指数最高（0.728）。最佳模型对各终点划分的风险组在 OS（中位数26.7 vs. 9.1个月，p < 0.001）和 LM 进展（p = 0.003）方面存在显著差异，但在中枢神经系统进展方面没有显著差异。仅基于影像的风险组在任何临床变量上均无显著差异，但高风险患者较少出现肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞（46% vs. 77%，p = 0.010）和 PD-L1 表达[≥] 50%（10% vs. 32%，p = 0.049）。结论：肺癌脑转移中的 MRI 影像组学生物标志物在既有临床变量之外提供预后信息，并与肿瘤免疫微环境特征相对应，支持其用于细化风险分层的潜力。

items.title: Beyond ICD Codes: Semantic IDs for Generative Medical Coding
items.abstract_or_text: Generative approaches to automatic International Classification of Diseases (ICD) coding use large language models (LLMs) to predict ICD codes from clinical documents. However, original ICD code strings are not ideal generation targets because the ICD hierarchy does not always reflect clinical relationships, and LLMs struggle to interpret and generate these codes. We introduce SemICD, a framework that trains LLMs to generate Semantic IDs (SIDs) instead. SemICD constructs SIDs by hierarchically clustering embeddings of textual code profiles, allowing semantically related codes to share prefixes while each complete SID uniquely identifies one ICD code. To align the SID tokens with clinical semantics, we employ two auxiliary tasks for bidirectional generation between textual code profiles and SIDs. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV with four LLMs show that SemICD outperforms direct code generation, improving Micro-F1 by 1.34-8.00 points. Our code is available at https://github.com/youwillbethebest/SemICD.
items.summary_zh: 临床相关预印本；SemICD 用层级聚类构造语义 ID，并在 MIMIC-III、MIMIC-IV 的四个 LLM 上将 Micro-F1 提高1.34–8.00个百分点，代码已公开。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 让生成式医疗编码目标显式反映概念层级，改善稀有和细粒度 ICD 概念的表示与可复现评测。
items.abstract_zh: 自动国际疾病分类（ICD）编码的生成式方法使用大型语言模型（LLM）从临床文档预测 ICD 编码。然而，原始 ICD 编码字符串并不是理想的生成目标，因为 ICD 层级并不总是反映临床关系，而且 LLM 难以解释和生成这些编码。我们提出 SemICD，一种训练 LLM 生成语义 ID（SID）的框架。SemICD 对文本编码描述的嵌入进行层次聚类来构造 SID，使语义相关的编码共享前缀，同时每个完整 SID 唯一对应一个 ICD 编码。为使 SID 词元与临床语义对齐，我们采用两个辅助任务，在文本编码描述与 SID 之间进行双向生成。在 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV 上使用四个 LLM 的实验显示，SemICD 优于直接编码生成，使 Micro-F1 提高1.34–8.00个百分点。代码见 https://github.com/youwillbethebest/SemICD。

items.title: Definition Grounding in Theory-Level Auto-formalization
items.abstract_or_text: LLM-based auto-formalization systems can now generate formally verified Lean code at unprecedented rates. However, a formalization advances mathematical research only when further mathematical results can be built on it, especially when its definitions and helper lemmas are general enough to be imported and used idiomatically. We propose definition grounding, where definition formalizations are continuously judged and revised, as a method to ensure formalization quality. We find that agents formalizing definitions from textbook text often produce definitions that later statements cannot use, and only 25%-50% of their definition sets are compatible with all later statements. However, clarifying the informal definitions can improve this rate up to 77.5% averaged over all models. Furthermore, stating a small set of basic properties without proving them can improve model judges' capability to detect definitions with compatibility issues, at only about 11% of the definition formalization cost. These results are verified with ReuseBench, a benchmark we curated for formalizing new mathematical fields and theories.
items.summary_zh: Definition grounding 通过持续判断和修订定义，评估理论级自动形式化是否产生可复用、能支撑后续定理的 Lean 定义；ReuseBench 显示定义兼容性仍是主要瓶颈。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“代码能否通过形式验证”推进到“定义能否被后续数学使用”，并用后续陈述兼容率和基准数据提供可复核的质量指标。
items.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的自动形式化系统如今能够以前所未有的速率生成经过形式验证的 Lean 代码。然而，只有当形式化结果能够支撑进一步的数学成果时，尤其是当其定义和辅助引理足够一般、可以被导入并按惯例使用时，形式化才会推进数学研究。我们提出 definition grounding：持续判断并修订定义，以确保形式化质量的一种方法。我们发现，agents 根据教材文本形式化定义时，经常产生后续陈述无法使用的定义；在所有模型中，定义集合中只有 25%–50% 能与后续全部陈述兼容。澄清非形式化定义后，这一比例在所有模型上的平均值最高可提高到 77.5%。此外，在不证明一小组基本性质的情况下陈述这些性质，也能提高模型评审者发现定义兼容性问题的能力，而成本约只有定义形式化成本的 11%。这些结果通过我们整理的 ReuseBench 得到验证；该基准用于形式化新的数学领域和理论。

items.title: Explore with Memory, Learn without It: In-Context Exploration and Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Exploration bounds learning efficiency in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Current methods explore mostly through independent sampling, without fully using the information gathered along the way, such as known wrong answers and environment feedback. We propose LEAF, which injects a dynamic, problem-specific memory into the context before every rollout. The memory contains the most recent response, its reward, and other environment feedback. It is updated after every verifier call. We decouple policy updates from rollouts and update the policy through self-distillation. On four benchmarks and two open models, LEAF accelerates exploration by about 4x compared with a random sampling baseline. On unseen test sets, it improves accuracy over the strongest baseline by 1.59 and 1.83 percentage points on the two models, while using less compute than any RL baseline. These results highlight the potential of LEAF in improving both exploration and learning efficiency. Code is available at: https://github.com/on1262/LEAF
items.summary_zh: LEAF 把最近回答、奖励和环境反馈写入动态问题级记忆，在可验证奖励强化学习中配合自蒸馏提高探索效率；在未见测试集上以更少计算取得小幅准确率提升。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 使用 verifier 调用后的真实反馈更新记忆，并在未见测试集及两个开放模型上评测，结果可用于检验探索记忆是否带来泛化而非只增加采样。
items.abstract_zh: 探索限制了带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）的学习效率。当前方法主要通过独立采样进行探索，没有充分利用过程中收集的信息，例如已知的错误答案和环境反馈。我们提出 LEAF，在每次 rollout 之前把动态的、问题特定的记忆注入上下文。该记忆包含最近一次回答、它的奖励以及其他环境反馈，并在每次 verifier 调用后更新。我们将策略更新与 rollout 解耦，并通过自蒸馏更新策略。在四个基准和两个开放模型上，与随机采样基线相比，LEAF 将探索速度提高约 4 倍。在未见测试集上，它在两个模型上的准确率分别比最强基线高 1.59 和 1.83 个百分点，同时使用的计算量少于任何 RL 基线。这些结果表明，LEAF 有望提高探索和学习效率。代码见：https://github.com/on1262/LEAF。

items.title: Output Discipline Sets the Floor: A Falsification-Guided, Model-Agnostic Agent Protocol for Auditable Hypothesis-Driven Decision Making
items.abstract_or_text: What binds large language models on auditable, hypothesis-driven decision tasks, where every candidate can be checked against the evidence? On the public TCMEval-SDT benchmark for Traditional Chinese Medicine syndrome differentiation (200 cases), the binding constraint is output discipline and reasoning structure, not model capability alone: two years of model scaling move zero-shot scores by only -0.03 to +0.08, while output-discipline failures (non-terminating reasoning, format non-compliance, large run-to-run spread) persist even in frontier models. We test this with a model-agnostic agent framework formalizing decision making as a five-stage closed loop, enforced by a candidate x evidence matrix falsification protocol: every candidate is judged against every evidence item, at least half of the candidates must be falsified before a conclusion is licensed, and survivors are emitted in a machine-verifiable single-line format. Across five base models, the effect is sign-conditional on zero-shot output discipline: it rescues models whose discipline fails (DeepSeek-V4-Flash: +0.267/+0.271, entirely termination rescue), reduces a high-variance model's run-to-run standard deviation from 0.218 to 0.007 (Kimi K3), and significantly costs already-disciplined models (-0.087 to -0.120 on budget-matched Qwen3-4B/32B). Ablations attribute the cost to the candidate-bounded format layer and show the effect is independent of injected knowledge content (protocol-knowledge decoupling). The protocol also transfers to misinformation-robust mathematical reasoning, detecting injected false premises at 89.8% recall with a 6.8% false-positive rate (MCC 0.54; a flag-everything baseline scores 0) and restoring accuracy to the no-misinformation ceiling. Where zero-shot output discipline is weak, the reasoning protocol sets the floor; base-model capability always sets the ceiling.
items.summary_zh: 该协议把可审计决策形式化为候选项—证据矩阵的五阶段闭环，要求逐项证伪并输出机器可验证格式；在数学误导信息测试中能识别注入的错误前提。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它明确区分模型能力与输出纪律，并用召回率、误报率、MCC、消融和跨模型结果检验“可验证推理协议”是否有效。
items.abstract_zh: 在每个候选项都可以根据证据检查的、可审计的假设驱动决策任务上，是什么限制了大型语言模型？在公开的 TCMEval-SDT 基准（200 个案例）上，限制因素是输出纪律和推理结构，而不只是模型能力：两年的模型扩展使零样本得分仅变化 -0.03 到 +0.08，而不终止推理、不遵守格式以及运行间波动大等输出纪律问题，即使在前沿模型中仍然存在。我们通过一个与模型无关的 agent 框架检验这一点。该框架将决策形式化为五阶段闭环，并强制使用候选项 × 证据矩阵的证伪协议：每个候选项都要与每条证据核对，至少一半候选项必须被证伪后才能许可结论，幸存项以机器可验证的单行格式输出。在五个基础模型上，该协议的效果取决于零样本输出纪律：它挽救了纪律失败的模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash：+0.267/+0.271，完全来自终止问题的修复），将高方差模型 Kimi K3 的运行间标准差从 0.218 降至 0.007，同时使本来已有纪律的模型在预算匹配的 Qwen3-4B/32B 上显著下降（-0.087 至 -0.120）。消融实验将代价归因于候选项有界的格式层，并表明该效果独立于注入的知识内容（协议—知识解耦）。该协议还迁移到抗误导信息的数学推理：它以 89.8% 的召回率和 6.8% 的误报率检测注入的错误前提（MCC 0.54；“全部标记”基线得分为 0），并将准确率恢复到无误导信息时的上限。在零样本输出纪律较弱的地方，推理协议设定下限；基础模型能力始终设定上限。
